A video model films the creature from two cameras in one frame, front on the left and side on the right. A joint reader trained on that one creature finds every joint in both views. README excerpt: AbliteratedOutTheBox What is AbliteratedOutTheBox? AbliteratedOutTheBox is a fork of llama.cpp that gets any supported model to answer flagged harmful prompts, delivering the requested content instead of a refusal, at inference time and with the original weights left on disk unchanged. It needs no fit, no training, and no extra files: for each prompt llama-abliterate reads two directions from the prompt itself, by forcing the assistant to start a few comply versus refuse openings (and clean versus disclaimered openings), diffing the activations, and a look-ahead gate decides per prompt whether to remove them.
